text:
alex: dropping a quick design pass for the capacity controls screen. main changes: compact preset bar, stacked min/max on mobile, burst duration inline, GPU pool selector with "recommended" tag, and a renamed SLO control. figma link: https://redwood.mock/s/capacity-controls-v2.png
maria: this looks way cleaner. one request: label the min/max fields with units (GPUs) and make the increment step 1 by default.
owen: can we show effective max when burst enabled? e.g., Max GPUs: 4 (burst to 6) — helps reduce confusion about steady-state vs spike.
nina: +1. also add a tiny info row under the max field that only appears when burst is on: "Burst cap shows peak GPUs during bursts."
sam: presets are great. recommend showing a short subtitle under each pill like: "Cost saver — min 0 · max 2 · burst 30s" so users know what will change before they apply.
alex: agree, will add subtitle. question for accessibility folks: best contrast for the SLO slider thumb? current teal fails in some themes.
jess: ensure slider thumb contrast >= 4.5:1. recommend #002f4b for dark text on pale bg. also include aria-valuetext like "Latency target p99 250 milliseconds".
aria-bot: accessibility check: slider focus must be keyboard reachable and show a visible focus ring.
own: GPU pool selector: long lists are noisy — suggest showing "Recommended" at top with a compact reason e.g., "recommended (fits model size)" and group rest by region. include price-tier badges.
maria: keyboard nav: arrow keys should traverse options; use role=listbox + aria-activedescendant. voiceover reads need testing for grouped lists.
jess: also add aria-describedby on burst control linking to the duration explainer so screen readers read both state + duration.
alex: UX debate: inline guardrail warnings vs top banner. my preference: inline under the control where relevant + a compact sticky banner if any guardrails are tripped so people don't miss them after scrolling.
sam: inline for context, banner for discoverability — agreed. banner copy options: "Guardrail warnings — review below" or "Configuration requires attention". which tone do we want?
jess: tone should vary by account tier. production accounts -> stronger "Action required". self-serve -> "Review guardrail limits". we'll route copy selection to product rules.
own: telemetry ask: capture preset_id + manual_overrides when applied so we can see edits. also log burst usage as a separate metric for cost breakdown.
maria: backend note: tag burst allocations so billing and graphs can show "Burst" line item.
alex: quick mobile nit: preset pills should be horizontally scrollable chips on small screens instead of wrapping to multiple rows.
jess: accessibility nit: ensure chip focus is visible and chips are reachable via keyboard. add sr-only text for applied preset: "Preset applied: Cost saver".
aria-bot: snapshot created: capacity-controls-v2-review-1762201111 at 1762201116
alex: acceptance criteria (draft): 1) preset chips with subtitle + keyboard focus, 2) stacked min/max under 640px, 3) burst duration inline + burst cap detail, 4) SLO labeled as "Latency target (p99)" with aria-valuetext, 5) GPU pools recommended first + grouped by region, 6) inline guardrail messages + sticky banner, 7) telemetry tags for presets & burst.
sam: thanks — i'll open frontend + backend tickets. ping when Figma updated.
